findings.title: Log volume is unknown

findings.recommendation: Capture daily ingest, retention, label strategy, and query expectations before target sizing.

findings.title: Retention requirements are not captured
findings.description: Datadog inventory does not fully describe retention expectations for metrics, logs, or traces.
findings.recommendation: Document retention and volume assumptions before sizing Grafana LGTM components.

findings.title: Trace volume is unknown
findings.description: The inventory does not include trace volume assumptions needed for Tempo sizing.
findings.recommendation: Capture spans per second, retention, sampling policy, and search expectations before target sizing.

findings.title: Unsupported dashboard widgets found
findings.description: Production API Overview has 1 widget(s) that need manual Grafana review.
findings.recommendation: Generate a Grafana dashboard candidate and manually review unsupported widgets before parity sign-off.

findings.title: Anomaly detection monitor needs manual replacement
findings.description: Datadog anomaly detection has no automatic PromQL equivalent.
findings.recommendation: Design an explicit Prometheus/Grafana alerting strategy and shadow it before cutover.

findings.title: Manual alert routing review is needed
findings.description: OpenExit does not automatically map Datadog notification handles to target alert routes.
findings.recommendation: Create explicit target contact points and routing policies, then test them without production paging.

findings.title: Monitor ownership is unclear

findings.title: Monitor has no runbook link

findings.title: Datadog-specific monitor query requires manual conversion
